The '''Mysterious Woman''' is an unknown being sometimes referred to by the community as '''Goddess''' or '''Lucia'''. She is an enigmatic entity donning a silver dress and planetary halo. Despite her occasional appearances throughout the game, there is no confirmed information regarding her true identity or her connection with Rover.

==Appearances==
* During the game's opening cutscene ''Set Sail''.
* As a Hologram in {{Quest|Rewinding Raindrops}}.
* Seen from a distance in {{Quest|The Bygone Shall Always Return}}.

==Speculations==
Please understand these are collected speculations and not confirmation. {{color|old|Possible spoilers.}}
* Implied to be '''Instance One''', part of a pair with '''Instance Two''', who is confirmed to be [[Shorekeeper]]<ref>[[Resolution K626]]</ref><ref>{{Quest|The Bygone Shall Always Return}}</ref>. 
* Possibly from or created by the Hé Civilization, an ancient civilization known by the [[Court of Savantae]] as "divine beings"<ref>"They were likely studying an ancient civilization they deemed to be "divine beings", but later got denounced from the CSC due to their extreme methods." {{Quest|Rewinding Raindrops}}</ref>.
* (No proof) Speculated to be the reason for Rover's missing memories.
* (No proof) Speculated to have implanted [[Abby]] within Rover. 
* Speculated to be the woman with white hair mentioned by a [[Court of Savantae|Court of Savantae scientist]] during [[The Star That Voyages Far]], although her hair in all known appearances have been black. 
*Possibly related to the [[Homeland Civilization]].
